profile.headline: Senior Staff Software Engineer at Criteo

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Generated daily personalized product recommendations using machine learning algorithms.
- Architected chatbot leveraging NLP to respond to customer requests in real-time.
- Enabled in-message order processing utilizing Stripe payments.
- Integrated with multiple suppliers to support dropship and cross-dock fulfillment strategies.
- Created open-source Java REST client for Facebook Messenger ( https://github.com/MessageYes/facebook-messenger ).

positions.title: Software Development Engineer II
positions.description:
Amazon Campus:
- Responsible for all customer and associate facing software used to launch, operate and support Amazon’s first physical retail locations.
- Implemented DynamoDB-backed workflow processes for package delivery at physical pickup points.
- Calculated live estimated wait times based on real-time capacity and employee availability.

Detail Page Express: 
- Led multi-team migration of the detail page rendering platform from Perl to Spring MVC.
- Coordinated task assignments and daily conference calls for local and remote development teams.
- Leveraged user device attributes to provide responsive HTML for product detail pages.
- Developed product attribute mock test framework for ad-hoc and automated UI tests.

Amazon Fashion Technology:
- Built Lucene search engine for retrieval of fashion products using contextually similar products.
- Designed customer profiles to provide personalized fashion recommendations in marketing emails.
- Mentored junior and peer engineers with 1:1 guidance and weekly tech-talks.

Retail Customer Experience
- Created several AJAX widgets to improve website customer experience and product discoverability.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Data Structures and Algorithms - 4 semesters
Introductory Programming - 1 semester

- Taught recitation sections to accompany and reinforce concepts discussed during lecture.
- Developed and evaluated programming assignments and written examinations.

positions.title: Consultant Intern
positions.description:
- Implemented numerous AJAX webflows for a medical point-of-sale .NET web application.
- Automated insurance claim generation into both physical and electronic documents.
- Programmatically submitted insurance claims through insurance carrier websites.
- Interfaced credit card acquisition hardware with the software to validate and store card information.
- Generated administrative reports using Crystal Reports with dynamic scanable barcodes and corporate logos.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Managed a server diagnostic utility project to oversee company owned servers.
- Utilized a rules engine to facilitate troubleshooting problems with the servers.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Computer Science with an Additional Major in German

patents.title: Multi-index Search Engines
patents.description: Systems and methods for performing multi-index searches are described in which a search string may be received, and processed by first running the query through a general search index, such as an Internet or e-commerce search. The results of the general search may then be analyzed to determine an appropriate context for the search query, e.g. clothing, sports, games, etc. The search query may then be processed using a second search index that is tuned to the specific context of the search query.
